events.region: Tazewell, VA; Mercer, WV; Summers, WV
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Portions of southwest Virginia, including the following
county, Tazewell and southeast West Virginia, including the
following counties, Mercer and Summers.

* WHEN...Until 400 AM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1144 PM EDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the warned area. Between 2 and 4 inches of rain
have fallen.
- This includes the following streams and drainages...
Camp Creek, Glade Branch, Crane Creek, Little Bluestone
River, Jumping Branch, Laurel Fork, Flipping Creek, Big
Branch, Bluestone River and Clark Branch.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Hinton, Matoaka, Camp Creek, Pocahontas, Bramwell, Camp Creek
State Park and Flat Top.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
...RED FLAG WARNING REMAINS IN EFFECT FROM 11 AM TO 8 PM MDT MONDAY
DUE TO GUSTY WINDS AND LOW RELATIVE HUMIDITY FOR FALL RIVER COUNTY
AREA, NORTHERN FOOT HILLS, EASTERN FOOT HILLS, CUSTER COUNTY PLAINS,
PINE RIDGE AREA, BUTTE COUNTY AREA, PERKINS COUNTY, WEST CENTRAL
PLAINS, ZIEBACH COUNTY, HAAKON COUNTY AREA, BADLANDS AREA, BENNETT
COUNTY AREA, AND WESTON COUNTY PLAINS...

* AFFECTED AREA...Fire Weather Zones 317, 322, 323, 324, 325, 326,
327, 328, 329, 330, 331, 332, and 333.

* TIMING...From 11 AM to 8 PM MDT Monday.

* WINDS...North winds 25 to 35 mph with gusts up to 50 mph.

* RELATIVE HUMIDITY...Relative Humidity between 18 to 26 percent.

* IMPACTS...Any fires that develop will spread rapidly. Outdoor
burning is not recommended.
